运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

第一轮 Adapter 有非零梯度、骨干梯度为 None；detach 后 Adapter 梯度为 None；eval 后参数仍然 requires_grad=True。

python 05_autograd_demo.py环境配置

冻结中间模块，验证前面的 Adapter 仍能训练

05_autograd_demo.py
import torchfrom torch import nn torch.manual_seed(0)# STEP 1: Adapter -> 冻结骨干 -> 预测头adapter = nn.Linear(4, 4, bias=False)backbone = nn.Linear(4, 4, bias=False)head = nn.Linear(4, 1, bias=False)with torch.no_grad():    backbone.weight.copy_(torch.eye(4))backbone.requires_grad_(False)x = torch.randn(6, 4)target = torch.randn(6, 1) # STEP 2: 冻结权重，但保留对骨干输入的导数prediction = head(backbone(adapter(x)))loss = (prediction - target).square().mean()loss.backward()assert adapter.weight.grad is not Noneassert backbone.weight.grad is Noneassert head.weight.grad is not Noneprint("adapter grad norm:", adapter.weight.grad.norm().item()) # STEP 3: 故意 detach，观察前面的训练路径消失for module in (adapter, backbone, head):    module.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)feature = backbone(adapter(x)).detach()(head(feature) - target).square().mean().backward()assert adapter.weight.grad is Noneassert head.weight.grad is not Noneprint("after detach, adapter grad:", adapter.weight.grad)adapter.eval()assert adapter.weight.requires_gradprint("eval does not freeze parameters:", adapter.weight.requires_grad)
